SELECT COALESCE(SUM(item.refund_quantity), 0) FROM dms_shop_after_sale_item item INNER JOIN dms_shop_after_sale sale ON sale.id = item.after_sale_id WHERE item.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND sale.status IN (0, 4, 5, 6)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(item.refund_quantity), 0) FROM dms_shop_after_sale_item item INNER JOIN dms_shop_after_sale sale ON sale.id = item.after_sale_id WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} AND sale.status = 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(item.refund_amount), 0) FROM dms_shop_after_sale_item item INNER JOIN dms_shop_after_sale sale ON sale.id = item.after_sale_id WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} AND sale.status = 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(order_item.cost_amount, 0) * item.refund_quantity), 0) FROM dms_shop_after_sale_item item INNER JOIN dms_shop_after_sale sale ON sale.id = item.after_sale_id INNER JOIN dms_shop_order_item order_item ON order_item.id = item.order_item_id WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} AND sale.status = 1
